versions.description: Player reports: players type `report <player> <reason>` (or `report <reason>` for general issues) to open a numbered ticket. Staff online with REPORTS_RECEIVE get a PM, and an optional Discord channel gets an alert. Each ticket stores the reporter's and target's position and online status, plus the target's last chat lines. Staff use `reports`, `reportview <id>` and `reportclose <id> [note]`; the reporter is told when it is closed. Cooldown and max open reports stop spam.

commands.name: report
commands.description: Report a player or a problem to staff
commands.helpText: report <player> <reason> - report a player. report <reason> - report a general problem.

arguments.name: text
arguments.helpText: Player name followed by the reason, or just the reason

commands.name: reports
commands.helpText: Lists the newest open reports. Needs REPORTS_MANAGE.

commands.name: reportview
commands.description: Staff: show one report with its context
commands.helpText: reportview <id> - shows reporter, target, positions, reason and chat context. Needs REPORTS_MANAGE.

commands.name: reportclose
commands.description: Staff: close a report, optionally with a note
commands.helpText: reportclose <id> [note] - closes the report and tells the reporter. Needs REPORTS_MANAGE.

hooks.name: deliver-notices
hooks.description: Tells reporters about reports that were closed while they were offline

functions.name: report-helpers

permissions.description: Gets an in-game PM when a player files a report.
Can list, view and close reports (reports, reportview, reportclose).
